issue.body:
scope_key=SCALP7_15M30M_BROAD_REBUILD_MATERIAL_FUSION_AFTER_PR1333_V1

Use latest origin/master and read these as SSOT before execution:
- PR #1331 — current Scalp7 15m/30m scope correction
- PR #1332 — rejected Squeeze common-mode owner diagnostic
- PR #1333 — multi-benchmark sprint + frozen Squeeze BE1R child
- `research/campaigns/scalp7_20260915/SCALP7_WORK_HANDOFF_AFTER_CHAT_BENCHMARK_V1.md`
- `research/campaigns/scalp7_20260915/SCALP7_MULTI_BENCHMARK_SPRINT_V1.json`

Current Top7 is Scalp7 15m/30m only. Do not count legacy Active5 1h, TrendRider Broad, or old G4/G5 conveyor as current evidence.

Work owns the long-running parallel lane:
1. Rebuild Trend Rider, Break, Supertrend at architecture/event-grammar/lifecycle level on exact 15m/30m identities. Do not repeat the simple ADX/DMI, Aroon, KAMA/ER, CMO, strong-close overlay tests already rejected by Chat.
2. Keep Keltner frozen except add-only orthogonal children. Independently validate the frozen Squeeze PANIC-long BE1R lifecycle child; no retune. Build proper MR pair-formation/trading-window child. Bind Micro raw microstructure into a frozen 15m/30m decision layer.
3. Build event-centered candle/chart anatomy for winners, losers, immediate failures, MFE givebacks and fat-tail winners. Features must be causal at signal/entry/in-trade time.
4. Run 12-month rolling walk-forward; extend toward 24 months only where genuine source coverage exists. No synthetic history. Run simultaneous frozen fresh-forward for all seven lanes.
5. Run C4->B material grade-up in parallel for `rbreaker_like`, `rsi_swing_fail`, `trend_ma_macd`, `turtle_trend`, max 3 one-axis rounds each. Do not reopen brute-force CxC. Start BxB only after >=2 independent B materials (behavior cosine <0.85), then fresh validate before host touch.
6. Report exact timeframe, frozen SHA/identity, T, T/day, WR, gross/net PnL, Net/T, PF, DD, MaxLS, loss tail, rolling-positive-window ratio, fresh T, monthly/symbol/session/winner concentration and final state for all seven lanes. Return a separate material/fusion table.

Primary objective: find materially better economics — ideally T/WR/Net higher with DD/MaxLS lower — without threshold loosening, post-holdout retune, forced trades, or hidden legacy evidence. Weak lanes remain WATCH/REBUILD; do not force seven Core promotions. Orders/live remain BLOCKED.
